We are 30 women in a savings group. We want to see who has paid and everyone’s turn from a basic phone.
My patients call all day long. I want them to pick a slot online and get an SMS reminder the day before.

missions.intro: Clients are looking for a developer for a mission. Browse the open ones, or publish yours.
missions.aucuneMiennes: You don't have any mission yet.
missions.indisponible: Missions are not available right now. Try again in a moment.

nouvelle.intro: Describe what you are looking for. You first save a draft that nobody sees: you publish it when it is ready.
nouvelle.champTitre: In one sentence, what are you looking for?
nouvelle.aideTitre: For example: a website for my association.
nouvelle.aideBesoin: At least {n} characters: what the developer must do, for whom, and what matters to you.
nouvelle.aideCompetences: Separate them with commas, for example: vue, spring, ux design.
nouvelle.aideBudget: Leave empty if you prefer to discuss it.

invalide.titre: The title must be between 3 and 120 characters.
invalide.besoin: The description must be at least 20 characters.
invalide.competences: Give one to ten skills, each in a word or two.
invalide.budget: The budget is not a valid amount.
invalide.visibilite: Choose who can see the mission.

detail.publierAide: It will be visible to all developers. You can close it at any time.

detail.seConnecter: Sign in to offer my services
detail.introuvable: This mission does not exist, or you are not allowed to see it.

suivi.accepteAutomatiquement: Accepted automatically on {date}, without an answer from the client.
suivi.payerAide: Payment happens outside Jamii (mobile money, bank transfer…). Declaring it here keeps a record for both of you.

demarrer.intro: The quote is accepted. Give the developer what they need to start.
demarrer.aide: Access, content, useful contacts. Never put a password here: share it another way.

livrer.aideMessage: At least 10 characters: what is done, and how to check it.
livrer.aideLiens: One link per line, five at most, using https: test version, repository, files.
livrer.liensInvalides: Each link must start with https://, and five links at most.

retouche.ouvrir: Request a revision ({n} left) | Request a revision ({n} left)
retouche.aide: At least 10 characters, as precise as possible.
retouche.epuisees: All the revisions included in the quote have been used.

erreurs.annulation_non_permise: A delivered milestone is waiting for an answer: report a disagreement instead.

annulation.aide: If the other party agrees, the mission is cancelled. You can cancel on your own if the client has not given the starting information 7 days after agreeing on the quote, or if a milestone is more than 7 days late. Otherwise, your request waits for their answer.
annulation.aideAccord: The other party has already asked to cancel: confirming cancels the mission.
annulation.enAttente: You asked to cancel. The request is waiting for the other party.

demandeePar.client: The client is asking to cancel the mission.
demandeePar.developpeur: The developer is asking to cancel the mission.

desaccord.aide: A Jamii moderator reads what happened and decides. Until then, deliveries, revisions and automatic acceptance are on hold.
desaccord.aideRaison: At least 20 characters: what the quote said, and what was done.
desaccord.enAttente: A moderator will look into it.

issues.terminee: Decision: the mission is considered finished.

trancher.aide: At least 20 characters. Both parties will read it.

avis.question: How did the mission go?
avis.aide: 1,000 characters at most. The review cannot be changed afterwards.
